user.title: SA CFS Fire Danger Setup
user.description:
Please select the fire ban districts you wish to create individual sensors for. 

If you select none, only the main summary sensor (`sensor.sa_cfs_fire_danger`) will be created.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the CFS server to retrieve the list of regions. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_regions_found: No fire ban districts were found in the data from the CFS server.

init.title: Update Monitored Regions
init.description: Select the fire ban districts you wish to monitor. Deselecting a region will remove its sensor.
